patchBoard.ground: Safe pedestrian ground within the illustrated activity, never unsupported air or traffic
patchBoard.wardrobe: Warm ochre insulated jacket, muted teal snow trousers, dark snow boots and gloves; hood down behind neck so the face and curly hair remain clear.

placement.occlusion: Allow partial natural overlap from a nearby object only below the face. The whole face, eyes and curls must remain recognizable. No merged hands or limbs.
